record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase the existing causal recency-pooling mixture from 0.25 to 0.40 and its half-life from 3 to 4 observed interactions. The previous pooling improvement motivates testing slightly broader recent-interest retention while keeping substantial weight on the current GRU state. Apply identical causal pooling during training and inference, mask padding, retain final-real-position selection, and save both settings in predictor metadata. Keep other components fixed.
